packs.name: Blender
packs.author: raisinhvh
packs.description: Inspect and edit open Blender sessions: run Python (bpy), browse the scene, read/write properties, capture viewport images, render PNG icons and thumbnails, check meshes for game readiness, import, save and export models (including a Roblox FBX preset), convert armature actions or animation FBX files for roblox_import_animation, and look up the bpy API of the running version. Supports several Blender windows at once.

packs.name: Figma
packs.author: raisinhvh
packs.description: Inspect and edit open Figma design files through the Unify Bridge development plugin: list pages, browse the layer tree, find nodes, read/set selection and node properties, capture node images, export PNG/JPG/SVG/PDF files to disk (one node or batches at several scales), and run Figma Plugin API JavaScript. Requires the Figma desktop app with the Unify Bridge plugin running (figma_install_plugin) and the pairing code entered.

packs.name: Imaging
packs.author: raisinhvh
packs.description: Headless image editing with ImageMagick: trim, resize, pad, outline, drop shadow, layer, text, color adjust, sprite sheets, tile slicing, icon sets, format conversion and PNG optimization, plus optional AI background removal and upscaling. All paths are absolute; results include a small preview image.

packs.name: Premiere
packs.author: raisinhvh
packs.description: Edit Adobe Premiere Pro through a local CEP panel: inspect projects/timelines, import media, organize bins, create sequences, insert/trim/move/remove/razor clips, add tracks and .mogrt titles, set effect parameters and keyframes, mute tracks, add markers, capture frames, export via Media Encoder with job status, and execute ExtendScript. Built for Premiere Pro 2023 (23.x); requires CEP support and an open Unify Bridge panel.

packs.name: Roblox
packs.author: raisinhvh
packs.description: Inspect and run Luau, edit scripts, search Creator Store audio (roblox_search_audio), capture viewport images (saved as PNG or uploaded as image assets), read output logs and selection, and control playtests across multiple Roblox Studio places through the paired Unify Bridge plugin. Uploads models, images, decals, audio, video, and Blender/FBX animations to the group through Open Cloud, inserts models into Studio, and manages uploaded assets (info, metadata, new model versions, version history, rollback, archive/restore, experience permissions, upload quotas).

packs.name: Sound
packs.author: raisinhvh
packs.description: Find, create, shape and export game sound effects. Workflow: find (roblox_search_audio from the Roblox toolpack -> use rbxassetid://<id> directly, or sound_fetch rbx:<id>; sound_search_freesound (CC0 only) -> sound_fetch) or create (sound_generate = local AI text-to-SFX, sound_synth = code synthesis recipes) -> sound_process / sound_mix -> sound_analyze -> sound_export -> roblox_create to upload. Agents cannot hear: judge sounds with the analyze numbers and the waveform/spectrogram PNG, and use send_media so the user can listen before anything is uploaded. Every written file gets a <file>.sfxinfo provenance sidecar (source, licence, args). Slow work runs as jobs (sound_job). Unify builds the core Python environment when the pack installs; sound_status shows what is ready and what is missing.
